# Workflow to create global whaling activity map on Google Earth Engine using JavaScript

```{javascript}
// Inspect the imported whaling-area table
print("Whaling areas", whaling_areas_gee);

// View the first record and its properties
print("First record", whaling_areas_gee.first());
```

```{javascript}
// 1. CREATE PROPORTIONAL WHALING-AREA POINTS

// Assign a display color to each dominant operation type
var operationColors = ee.Dictionary({
'Aboriginal': '1B9E77',
'Commercial': 'D95F02',
'Illegal': '000000',
'Special permit': '7570B3',
'Unknown': 'FFD92F'
});

// Convert each whaling-area bounding box into a representative center point
var whaling_points = whaling_areas_gee.map(function(feature) {

// Extract geographic boundaries
var minLat = ee.Number(feature.get('min_lat'));
var maxLat = ee.Number(feature.get('max_lat'));
var minLon = ee.Number(feature.get('min_lon'));
var maxLon = ee.Number(feature.get('max_lon'));

// Calculate the representative center latitude
var centerLat = minLat.add(maxLat).divide(2);

// Calculate the representative center longitude
// Correct for whaling areas that cross the International Date Line
var lonSpan = maxLon.subtract(minLon);

var centerLon = ee.Number(
ee.Algorithms.If(
lonSpan.gt(180),
minLon.add(maxLon.add(360)).divide(2),
minLon.add(maxLon).divide(2)
)
);

// Convert longitudes greater than 180 back into the -180 to 180 range
centerLon = ee.Number(
ee.Algorithms.If(
centerLon.gt(180),
centerLon.subtract(360),
centerLon
)
);

// Create a point at the center of the whaling area
var point = ee.Geometry.Point([centerLon, centerLat]);

// Extract total catch
var catchTotal = ee.Number(feature.get('total_catch'));

// Square-root scaling prevents large catches from dominating the map
var pointSize = catchTotal.sqrt().divide(4).add(3);

// Get the dominant operation type
var operation = ee.String(feature.get('dominant_operation'));

// Assign its corresponding color
var operationColor = ee.String(operationColors.get(operation));

// Retain original attributes and attach styling information
return ee.Feature(point, feature.toDictionary())
.set('style', {
pointSize: pointSize,
pointShape: 'circle',
color: '303030',
fillColor: operationColor.cat('99'),
width: 1
});
});
```

```{javascript}
// 2. DISPLAY PROPORTIONAL CATCH MAP

// Apply the individual styling stored in each feature
var whaling_points_vis = whaling_points.style({
styleProperty: 'style',
neighborhood: 50
});

// Add the whaling points to the map
Map.addLayer(
whaling_points_vis,
{},
'Global whaling catch'
);

// Set satellite imagery as the default basemap
Map.setOptions('SATELLITE');

// Set initial global view
Map.setCenter(0, 25, 2);
```

```{javascript}
// 3. ADD OPERATION TYPE LEGEND

// Create legend panel
var legend = ui.Panel({
style: {
position: 'bottom-left',
padding: '8px 12px',
backgroundColor: 'white'
}
});

// Add map title
legend.add(
ui.Label({
value: 'Global Whaling Activity, 1986–2024',
style: {
fontWeight: 'bold',
fontSize: '16px',
margin: '0 0 10px 0'
}
})
);

// Add legend subtitle
legend.add(
ui.Label({
value: 'Dominant Operation Type',
style: {
fontWeight: 'bold',
fontSize: '14px',
margin: '0 0 6px 0'
}
})
);

// Helper function for adding one legend row
function addLegendRow(color, label) {

var colorBox = ui.Label({
style: {
backgroundColor: '#' + color,
padding: '8px',
margin: '0 6px 4px 0'
}
});

var description = ui.Label({
value: label,
style: {
margin: '0 0 4px 0'
}
});

var row = ui.Panel({
widgets: [colorBox, description],
layout: ui.Panel.Layout.Flow('horizontal')
});

legend.add(row);
}

// Add each operation category
addLegendRow('1B9E77', 'Aboriginal');
addLegendRow('D95F02', 'Commercial');
addLegendRow('000000', 'Illegal');
addLegendRow('7570B3', 'Special permit');
addLegendRow('FFD92F', 'Unknown');

// Explain the symbol-size encoding
legend.add(
ui.Label({
value: 'Circle size = cumulative catch',
style: {
fontStyle: 'italic',
fontSize: '11px',
margin: '6px 0 0 0'
}
})
);

// Add legend to map
Map.add(legend);
```

```{javascript}
// 4. ADD CLICK-TO-INSPECT PANEL

// Create information panel
var infoPanel = ui.Panel({
style: {
position: 'top-left',
width: '280px',
padding: '10px',
backgroundColor: 'white'
}
});

// Initial instruction
infoPanel.add(
ui.Label({
value: 'Whaling Area Information',
style: {
fontWeight: 'bold',
fontSize: '16px'
}
})
);

infoPanel.add(
ui.Label('Click a whaling circle to view details.')
);

// Add panel to map
Map.add(infoPanel);

// Respond when the user clicks the map
Map.onClick(function(coords) {

// Create a point at the clicked coordinates
var clickPoint = ee.Geometry.Point([coords.lon, coords.lat]);

// Find the nearest whaling-area point within 500 km
var clickedFeature = whaling_points
.map(function(feature) {
return feature.set(
'click_distance',
feature.geometry().distance(clickPoint)
);
})
.filter(ee.Filter.lte('click_distance', 500000))
.sort('click_distance')
.first();

// Retrieve the selected feature's properties
clickedFeature.evaluate(function(feature) {

// Clear previous information
infoPanel.clear();

infoPanel.add(
ui.Label({
value: 'Whaling Area Information',
style: {
fontWeight: 'bold',
fontSize: '16px'
}
})
);

// If a whaling point was found near the click
if (feature) {

var properties = feature.properties;

// Create cleaner display names for selected areas
var displayArea =
properties.area === 'Antarctic' ? 'Antarctic (Japan/USSR)' :
properties.area === 'Atlantic N' ? 'Atlantic N (Norway)' :
properties.area === 'Atlantic NE' ? 'Atlantic NE (Norway)' :
properties.area === 'CanadaW,Arctic' ? 'Arctic (Canada)' :
properties.area === 'Canada HudsnBy' ? 'Hudson Bay (Canada)' :
properties.area === 'W.Indies' ? 'West Indies' :
properties.area === 'Bonin Is' ? 'Bonin Is (Japan)' :
properties.area === 'JapnN/Kuril Is' ? 'Kuril Is (Japan)' :
properties.area === 'Pacific NW' ? 'Pacific NW (Japan)' :
properties.area;

// Add area name
infoPanel.add(
ui.Label({
value: displayArea,
style: {
fontWeight: 'bold',
fontSize: '14px',
margin: '8px 0 6px 0'
}
})
);

// Add total cumulative catch
infoPanel.add(
ui.Label(
'Total catch: ' +
Number(properties.total_catch).toLocaleString()
)
);

// Add dominant operation type
infoPanel.add(
ui.Label(
'Dominant operation: ' +
properties.dominant_operation
)
);

// Add operation breakdown heading
infoPanel.add(
ui.Label({
value: 'Operation Breakdown',
style: {
fontWeight: 'bold',
fontSize: '13px',
margin: '10px 0 4px 0'
}
})
);

// Add Aboriginal catch if greater than zero
if (properties.aboriginal_catch > 0) {

infoPanel.add(
ui.Label(
'Aboriginal: ' +
Number(properties.aboriginal_catch).toLocaleString() +
' (' +
Number(properties.aboriginal_pct).toFixed(1) +
'%)'
)
);

}

// Add Commercial catch if greater than zero
if (properties.commercial_catch > 0) {

infoPanel.add(
ui.Label(
'Commercial: ' +
Number(properties.commercial_catch).toLocaleString() +
' (' +
Number(properties.commercial_pct).toFixed(1) +
'%)'
)
);

}

// Add Illegal catch if greater than zero
if (properties.illegal_catch > 0) {

infoPanel.add(
ui.Label(
'Illegal: ' +
Number(properties.illegal_catch).toLocaleString() +
' (' +
Number(properties.illegal_pct).toFixed(1) +
'%)'
)
);

}

// Add Special permit catch if greater than zero
if (properties.special_permit_catch > 0) {

infoPanel.add(
ui.Label(
'Special permit: ' +
Number(properties.special_permit_catch).toLocaleString() +
' (' +
Number(properties.special_permit_pct).toFixed(1) +
'%)'
)
);

}

// Add Unknown catch if greater than zero
if (properties.unknown_catch > 0) {

infoPanel.add(
ui.Label(
'Unknown: ' +
Number(properties.unknown_catch).toLocaleString() +
' (' +
Number(properties.unknown_pct).toFixed(1) +
'%)'
)
);

}

} else {

infoPanel.add(
ui.Label(
'No whaling area found near this location.'
)
);

}

});

});
```
